business_summary: Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of home textile products in China and internationally. The company offers comforters, bedding sets, quilts, pillow cores, single-piece combinations, cushions, children's products, summer products, blankets, and other bedding products, as well as household goods. It sells its products under the Mercury Home Textiles, Mercury STRAZ HOME, Belles Home Textiles, Mercury Kids, BLISS, SHUIXING KIDS, and MERCURY BABY brands. Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 홈 텍스타일 제품의 연구, 디자인, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이불, 침구 세트, 이불, 베개 코어, 일체형 콤비네이션, 쿠션, 어린이 용품, 여름 용품, 담요 및 기타 침구 제품과 생활 용품을 제공합니다. Mercury Home Textiles, Mercury STRAZ HOME, Belles Home Textiles, Mercury Kids, BLISS, SHUIXING KIDS 및 MERCURY BABY 브랜드로 제품을 판매합니다. Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd.는 1987년에 설립되었으며 중국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
